metadata.description: Pinned set of third-party Claude Code plugins for an issue-to-PR delivery loop. Every entry is locked to a commit; bump pins on purpose with bin/check-pins.

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: Engineering workflow: grilling, specs, tickets, TDD, diagnosis, domain modeling. Owns requirements, decomposition, and implementation.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Simplicity rules applied while writing code: smallest complete change, reuse first, marked shortcuts.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Sharpen's gate chain and ship command. Owns review gates and PR creation.

plugins.name: grumpy
plugins.description: Sharpen's adversarial reviewer. Required by the sdlc gate chain for small-medium and larger changes.

plugins.name: agent-skills
plugins.description: Addy Osmani's production practices: security hardening, observability, CI/CD, launch and rollback. Opt in per repo.
